src: Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has different shapes for 6m and 8m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the sides have 3 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladder can be toggled in 2 height variants, and the ladder and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 大型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台。具有适配6m和8m排气口宽度的不同形状。基座框架提供9种颜色选项，侧边提供3种颜色选项。可配置用于压紧装置的多种可选支撑垫。爬梯可在2种高度构型间切换，且爬梯和栏杆提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

src: Medium size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has three different shapes for 4m and 6m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 中型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台，采用移动式轮组外观。具有适配4m和6m排气口宽度的三种不同形状。基座框架提供9种颜色选项。可配置用于压紧装置的多种可选支撑垫。爬梯支持多种构型切换，并提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

src: Micro size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has a two 1.5m wide exhaust holes with square and rectangular shapes, and a 2.5m wide square shape. The base frame has 8 color options. The ladders can be toggled on or off, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 微型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台。配有方形和矩形两种1.5m宽排气口，以及一个2.5m宽的方形排气口。基座框架提供8种颜色选项。爬梯可自由开关显示，并提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

src: Mini size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheels or fixed footing styles. Has a 3 shapes of exhaust holes in 1.5m and 2.5m widths, and a 3.5m square hole. The base frame has 8 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 迷你型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台，具有移动轮式或固定支脚外观。配有1.5m和2.5m宽度的3种形状排气口，以及一个3.5m的方形排气口。基座框架提供8种颜色选项。可配置用于压紧装置的多种可选支撑垫。爬梯支持多种构型切换，并提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

src: Small size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has two special exhaust hole variants for the BDB Atlas V and KNES Ariane 5, plus other shapes in 2m, 3m and 4m widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the side panels have 2 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 小型通用发射基座，节点连接式发射架平台，采用移动轮式风格。包含适用于 BDB Atlas V 和 KNES Ariane 5 的两种特殊排气孔变体，以及 2m、3m 和 4m 宽度的其他形状。基座框架有 9 种颜色可选，侧板有 2 种颜色可选。固定夹具的可选支撑垫支持多种配置。爬梯可切换多种配置，且有 5 种颜色可选。配备手动操作的电能与燃料生成器，必须手动开启方可工作，也可随时关闭。

src: BIG Extra Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Wider than the Sandbox/Tier 3 launch pad static, the support columns will sit in the ground. Has different shapes for 10m, 14m and 18m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 特大型通用发射基座，节点连接式发射架平台。宽度超过沙盒/3级发射台建筑，支撑柱会立于地面。具备 10m、14m 和 18m 排气孔宽度的不同形状。基座框架有 9 种颜色可选。固定夹具的可选支撑垫支持多种配置。爬梯和栏杆有 5 种颜色可选。配备手动操作的电能与燃料生成器，必须手动开启方可工作，也可随时关闭。

src: A specialized rectangular launch plate for the new TantaresLV Energia rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专为新型TantaresLV能源号火箭设计的矩形发射底盘。与发射台齐平；请将深色下段置于 VAB 地板下方以确保正确对齐。底盘配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A specialized rectangular launch plate designed for Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy-style rockets. Insert sections can be turned off for Falcon Heavy/tri-core rockets. The plate can accomodate the Large General Fallback Tower, attached to the node on the wider side of the plate. Use the Medium General Drop-Arm Hold-Downs for Falcon 9-sized (2.5m) rockets. There is also a special tower attach node for the Shuttle FSS Tower with Rodan Crew Arm. The plate also has rotattion options, to enable proper rotation of a non-square launch clamps. The plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专为 Falcon 9 和 Falcon Heavy 构型火箭设计的矩形发射底盘。用于 Falcon Heavy/三芯级火箭时可关闭嵌入段。底盘可容纳安装在较宽侧节点的通用大型倒伏塔。Falcon 9 尺寸（2.5m）火箭建议搭配中型通用落臂式固定夹具。此外还设有一个专用塔架连接节点，用于搭配配备 Rodan 乘员臂的航天飞机 FSS 塔架。底盘提供旋转选项以正确旋转非正方形发射架。底盘配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A specialty launch stand for the Delta IV rocket, both the single and triple-core versions. By default it is set up for the Delta IV from Bluedog Design Bureau, which has 3.125m diameter core tanks. By adjusting the positions and width of the umbilical masts and hold-down posts with the deploy limit sliders, tank sizes of 2.5m can be accomodated as well. The stand is designed to sit flush on the launch pad surface, so move the stand down until the dark band on the bottom of the large corner support columns is on or slightly extending into the floor of the VAB. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Delta IV Service Tower for the full LC-37 Delta IV recreation.
zh: 专为德尔塔IV号（Delta IV）火箭设计的专用发射台，同时支持单芯级和三芯级构型。默认配置适用于Bluedog Design Bureau的Delta IV（芯级贮箱直径3.125m）。通过展开限制滑块调节脐带塔和固定柱的位置与宽度，亦可适配2.5m直径贮箱。发射台设计为与发射台表面齐平，因此在VAB中请向下移动发射台，直至大型角撑柱底部的深色条纹贴齐或略微陷入地面。发射台配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。配合Delta IV勤务塔使用，可完整复刻LC-37Delta IV。

src: A general rectangular node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters with two small side boosters. Center and optional outer hold-down support plates can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit sliders. There are different combinations of integrated hold-down bolts and clamp arms, each of which can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The bolts can also be switched between short, tall and extended heights. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种通用的矩形节点连接式发射支架，适用于生涯早期，可适配直径为2.5m、1.875m、1.5m、1.25m、0.9375m及0.625m且带有两个小型侧向助推器的火箭。中心及可选的外侧固定支撑板可通过展开限制滑块调节长度。集成有多种组合形式的固定螺栓和压紧臂，均可通过展开限制滑块向内调节，以对齐贮箱底部或发动机安装架。螺栓还可在短、高以及加长高度之间切换。加长高度螺栓带有一个额外的高度调节滑块。支架还配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A specialized giant-sized round launch plate for the new TantaresLV N1 rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专为全新TantaresLV N1火箭设计的巨型圆形发射底座。其表面与发射台齐平；请将深色下半部分埋入VAB地面以下以确保正确对齐。底板配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A very low profile minimalist round launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 极低剖面的极简圆形发射稳定支架底座，发射底板与发射台齐平；请将深色下半部分埋入VAB地面以下以确保正确对齐。底板配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A very low profile minimalist square launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. Square or rectangular exhust hole configurations can be selected. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 极低剖面的极简方形发射稳定支架底座，发射底板与发射台齐平；请将深色下半部分埋入VAB地面以下以确保正确对齐。可选择方形或矩形排气孔配置。底板配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A modified version of the Atlas Launch Stand without a frame and with separately adjustable center and side section. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 宇宙神发射台的改进版本，无外框架且中心与侧面部分可单独调节。支架拥有8种配色方案，固定臂和侧面脐带管拥有2种配色方案。侧面脐带管与宇宙神管路连接器可关闭，以便适配其他1.875m直径的火箭。支架还配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A specialized launch stand for the Atlas SLV and derivatives from Bluedog Design Bureau, based on the real launch mount that the Atlas used. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专用于Bluedog Design Bureau的宇宙神SLV及其衍生型的专用发射台，基于宇宙神实际使用的发射台架设计。支架拥有8种配色方案，固定臂和侧面脐带管拥有2种配色方案。侧面脐带管与宇宙神管路连接器可关闭，以便适配其他1.875m直径的火箭。支架还配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A general round node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters. The stand can be configured as the base flat ring or with a conical extension. Support plates for the integrated hold-downs are configured separately, allowing a mix of bolts and clamp arms. The hold-down bolts are non-animated and have 4 configurations and 3 heights, and can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. There are optional integrated side clamps available in different configurations, and are also adjusted with their deploy limit slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种通用的节点连接式圆形发射支架，适用于生涯早期，可容纳2.5m、1.875m、1.5m、1.25m、0.9375m和0.625m直径的火箭。支架可配置为基础平环或锥形延伸段。内置压紧装置的支撑板可单独配置，支持螺栓与夹臂混用。压紧螺栓为无动画部件，提供4种配置与3种高度，可通过开启限制滑块向内调整，以对齐贮箱底部或发动机安装座。加高螺栓附带额外的高度调节滑块。可选的内置侧边夹臂有多种构型可选，同样可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。支架还配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

src: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising tiny rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.3125m or 0.625m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种高耸的节点连接式发射支架，用于将微型火箭架离地面。具有两种高度变体和8种配色方案。顶部的压紧螺栓可配置为适配0.3125m或0.625m直径的火箭，支持垂直或水平样式，亦可完全关闭螺栓。支架配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

src: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising small rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.9375, 1.25m or 1.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种高耸的节点连接式发射支架，用于将小型火箭架离地面。具有两种高度变体和8种配色方案。顶部的压紧螺栓可配置为适配0.9375m、1.25m或1.5m直径的火箭，支持垂直或水平样式，亦可完全关闭螺栓。支架配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

src: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising medium rockets up from the ground. Has three height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 1.875m or 2.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种高耸的节点连接式发射支架，用于将中型火箭架离地面。具有三种高度变体和8种配色方案。顶部的压紧螺栓可配置为适配1.875m或2.5m直径的火箭，支持垂直或水平样式，亦可完全关闭螺栓。支架配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

src: A specialty round node-attached launch clamp designed for the Redstone rocket from Bluedog Design Bureau, but also with optional hold-down bolt positions for standard 1.25m and 1.5m fuel tanks. There is also an integrated version of the Redstone Umbilical Pole, available in 6 heights at either 1.25m and 1.5m tank positions. The pole is dropped with the launch clamp release. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一款专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的红石（Redstone）火箭设计的节点连接式圆形发射支架，但同时也为标准 1.25m 和 1.5m 燃料箱提供了可选的压紧螺栓位置。该支架还集成了红石脐带塔，可在 1.25m 和 1.5m 燃料箱位置提供 6 种高度选择。脐带塔会在发射支架释放时脱落。发射台配备了两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: Node-attached launch clamp styled after various hold-down assemblies used by the Thor/Delta/Delta II rockets, sized for 1.5m diameter rockets. It is designed to sit flush with the ground, so move it down so the bottom sits slightly below the VAB floor. It has three style variants: Thor type, Delta II type and a mini type with just the hold-down mounts, and 8 color options. Each style has three hold-down bolt height options: short, tall and extra-tall, the latter two for use with SRB-using Thor/Delta variants. The bolts have two position options, either for the BDB LR-79 engine (early Thors and Deltas) or the RS-27 engine (later Deltas and all Delta IIs). The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 仿照雷神（Thor）/德尔塔（Delta）/德尔塔 II（Delta II）火箭所用各种压紧组件风格设计的节点连接式发射支架，适用于 1.5m 直径火箭。其设计为与地面齐平，因此请将其向下移动，使底部略低于 VAB 地面。包含三种外观变体：雷神型、德尔塔 II 型以及仅含压紧底座的迷你型，并提供 8 种颜色选择。每种外观都有三种压紧螺栓高度可选：低矮、高和超高，后两种用于搭载固体助推器的雷神/德尔塔型号。螺栓有两个位置选项，分别适配 BDB LR-79 发动机（早期雷神与德尔塔）或 RS-27 发动机（后期德尔塔与所有德尔塔 II）。发射台配备了两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

src: A specialty launch stand for the Titan III and Titan IV, inspired by the real one. The center section can be switched between Titan II style (flat) and Titan IV style (elevated). Integrated hold-down bolts in short and tall variants for both the core and side boosters can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders or separately turned off. The 4-corner support columns and the side wheels can be separately turned on/off. Special attach nodes for the Titan III Auxiliary Mast and Service Tower are located on the stand proper; other attach nodes are also available. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources, and 8 color options are available.
zh: 一款专为大力神 III（Titan III）和大力神 IV（Titan IV）设计的专用发射台，灵感源自现实原型。中心部分可在 Titan II 样式（平坦）和 Titan IV 样式（抬高）之间切换。芯级和侧边助推器均集成了矮版与高版的压紧螺栓，可通过开启限制滑块进行调节或单独关闭。四角的支撑柱和侧轮可单独开启/关闭。发射台主体上设有用于 Titan III 辅助桅杆和服务塔的专用连接节点；此外还提供了其他连接节点。发射台还配有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机，并提供 8 种颜色选项。

src: This is the free-standing base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes a built-in decoupler and an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. No launch clamps are necessary. Includes a manually-activated generator for electric charge. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional center-mount hold-down and Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes.
zh: 这是土星移动发射台的独立底座。底座通过排气口顶部的5号节点连接到火箭下级或芯级中心的空闲节点。发射塔底座段连接至发射台底座另一端的5号节点。内置分离器以及供乘员从地面到达顶层甲板的电梯。为获得最佳效果，请将前支腿放置在VAB地面大圆圈的白色区域内。无需发射稳定支架。包含手动启用的电能发电机。底座排气口可配置为适配三种尺寸的火箭：土星五号（6.4/5.625m）、SLS（5m）和土星1B（4.25/3.75m），并提供适配单芯级或三芯级火箭的多种正方形与长方形规格。提供多种可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的中心安装压紧装置与土星五号尾部服务桅杆连接节点。

src: This is the base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. Includes manually-activated generators for electric charge and fuel resources. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes.
zh: 这是土星移动发射台的底座。底座通过排气口顶部的5号节点连接到火箭下级或芯级中心的空闲节点。发射塔底座段连接至发射台底座另一端的5号节点。内置供乘员从地面到达顶层甲板的电梯。为获得最佳效果，请将前支腿放置在VAB地面大圆圈的白色区域内。包含手动启用的电能和燃料资源发生器。底座排气口可配置为适配三种尺寸的火箭：土星五号（6.4/5.625m）、SLS（5m）和土星1B（4.25/3.75m），并提供适配单芯级或三芯级火箭的多种正方形与长方形规格。提供多种可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的土星五号尾部服务桅杆连接节点。

src: Soyuz Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp pad styled after the actual Soyuz launch pad facility at Baikonur. Three color options are available. It attaches via the upper larger node in the central hole to a center node at the bottom of a rocket. The clamp arms, service gantry, large fuel arm, and small fuel arm are separately attached. The clamp arm pads can be switched among several options. 8 auxiliary nodes for the fuel arms or other tower are on the deck. Has two manual fuel and electric charge generators.
zh: 联盟号发射台底座，一种节点连接式发射固定架底座，样式仿照拜科努尔的真实联盟号发射场设施。提供三种配色选项。它通过中心孔内上方较大的节点连接至火箭底部的中心节点。夹抱臂、勤务塔架、大加注臂和小加注臂均为独立安装。夹臂垫块可在多个选项间切换。甲板上配有 8 个用于安装加注臂或其他塔架的辅助节点。配有两个手动燃料和电能发生器。

src: A specialty round quad-tripod node-attached launch clamp designed for the Titan II rocket from Bluedog Design Bureau. It's meant to sit flush with the top of the static launch pad, so move the stand down until the bottom edge is just below the floor of the VAB. The hold-down bolts on the top blocks have configurations for the BDB LR-87 engine or standard 1.875m tanks. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Titan II Service Tower and Titan II Crew Elevator for the full LC-19 recreation.
zh: 专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的大力神 II（Titan II）火箭设计的特制圆形四脚架节点附着发射架。设计上与静态发射台顶面平齐，因此请向下移动支架，直至底边刚好位于 VAB 地板下方。顶部构件上的压紧螺栓配有适用于 BDB LR-87 发动机或标准 1.875m 贮箱的构型。支架带有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机。搭配大力神 II 勤务塔和乘员电梯使用，可完整复现 LC-19。

src: A specialty square node-attached launch clamp designed for the Vanguard and Scout rockets from Bluedog Design Bureau. The hold-down structure in the center has configurations for the BDB Vanguard shrouded engine (2 types), bare engine/0.9375m tank and 1.25m tank; the structure can also be turned off so other hold-downs can be used instead. Optional nodes for the separate Redstone Umbilical Pole can be turned on. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Vanguard Service Tower for the full LC-18A recreation.
zh: 专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的先锋号（Vanguard）和侦察兵（Scout）火箭设计的特制方形节点附着发射架。中心的压紧结构配有适用于 BDB 先锋号带整流罩发动机（2种）、裸露发动机/0.9375m 贮箱以及 1.25m 贮箱的构型；该结构亦可关闭以使用其他压紧装置替代。可开启独立红石脐带柱的可选节点。支架带有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机。搭配先锋号勤务塔使用，可完整复现 LC-18A。

src: MR-104 Monopropellant Engine family originally provided in-space propulsion for the Voyager 1 and 2 and Magellan missions. Subsequent MR-104 variants provided propulsion for Landsat and NOAA as well as for other U.S. government programs. A variation of this engine (MR-104G) is to be used on the Orion Deep Space Exploration Vehicle. [Uses RCS Configuration]
zh: MR-104 单组元推进剂发动机系列最初为旅行者 1 号、2 号以及麦哲伦号任务提供在轨推进。随后的 MR-104 衍生型还为陆地卫星（Landsat）和美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）以及其他美国政府项目提供推进动力。该发动机的一款变型（MR-104G）计划用于猎户座深太空探索飞船。[使用 RCS 配置]

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The previous launch of the first navigation satellite proved the theories that Doppler shift timing can be used to precisely locate a point or location on the surface of the Earth using satellites. Put that concept into operational use with the first rudimentary satellite navigation network.

Build a navigation network with four NavSats that provide more frequent revisit rates than the single previous satellite. Make sure the satellites are spread around the Earth to provide reasonable coverage.&br;&br;NOTE: You may choose only the 3-satellite or 4-satellite contract.

NOTE: The satellites will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh:
项目：早期专注效益应用
类型：必要

先前第一颗导航卫星的发射证明了多普勒频移测时理论，即利用卫星可以精确确定地球表面某个点的位置。现在，通过建立第一个简易卫星导航网络，将这一概念投入实际运行。

建立一个包含四颗NavSats的导航网络，以提供比先前单颗卫星更高的重访频率。确保这些卫星分布在地球周围，以提供合理的覆盖范围。&br;&br;注意：你只能在 3 颗卫星或 4 颗卫星的合同中二选一。

注意：卫星将在合同完成后被销毁。此操作模拟将有效载荷移交给客户。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Communications around the globe are limited to line of sight because of the curvature of Earth. If we can launch a communications satellite into orbit, we can use it to transmit information to the opposite side of the world.

Historical example: Telstar 1 (78kg, Thor-Delta)

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh:
项目：早期专注效益应用
类型：必要

由于地球曲率的存在，全球通信受限于视距范围。如果我们能发射一颗通信卫星入轨，就可以利用它向地球的另一端传输信息。

历史参考：Telstar 1（78kg，雷神-德尔塔）

注意：卫星将在合同完成后被销毁。此操作模拟将有效载荷移交给客户。

src: A composite solid rocket motor designed as a drop-in replacement for the 5 Segment RSRM used on the Space Launch System (SLS). Its lower inert mass along with the higher surface thrust will enable the SLS to lift more than 130 metric tonnes into low Earth orbit.
zh: 一款复合材料固体火箭发动机，设计用作太空发射系统（SLS）上 5 级分段式 RSRM 的直接替代品。其更低的惰性质量与更高的海平面推力将使 SLS 能够将超过 130 吨的有效载荷送入近地轨道。

src: An American open cycle gas core nuclear rocket. NYRATH (Nuclear electrodYnamic Retention Advanced THermal) uses electrostatic confinment, instead of magnetic confinment, to contain the gaseous fissile core. By exploiting the difference between the ionization energies of uranium and hydrogen, an electrostatic nozzle can prevent fissile material from passing through while allowing hydrogen to leave unhindered. This allows for complete mixing of fissile material and propellant in the core, enabling extremely high energy transfer, and therefore extremely high performance.
zh: 一款美国开式循环气芯核火箭。NYRATH（核electrodYnamic滞留先进热力）采用静电约束而非磁约束来容纳气态易裂变核心。利用铀和氢电离能的差异，静电喷管可以阻止裂变材料穿过，同时允许氢气畅通无阻地排出。这使得裂变材料与推进剂在芯级中完全混合，实现极高的能量传递，从而获得极高的性能。

src: A small solid kick motor developed as a braking motor for the Ranger Block II rough lander. Repeated failures of the Ranger spacecraft meant the rough lander was never able to be deployed.
zh: 一种小型固体变轨发动机，专为徘徊者 Block II 硬着陆探测器设计用作制动发动机。由于徘徊者航天器屡次发射失败，硬着陆器从未真正得以部署。

src: RD-254 prototype (extrapolated from early RD-253 performance).
zh: RD-254原型机（由早期RD-253的性能推算而来）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 (270) degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. This keeps the satellite mostly to the northern hemisphere of the Earth. Place a satellite into a Molniya orbit.

There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya)

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh:
项目：早期专注效益应用
类型：必要

闪电轨道是一种高椭圆轨道，其倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角为 -90（270）度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。这使得卫星大部分时间都位于地球北半球上空。将一颗卫星送入闪电轨道。

地图视图和跟踪站中会显示一条目标轨道。你无需将卫星完全送入此轨道，它的作用是向你大致展示近地点和远地点应处的位置，更重要的是展示轨道的正确形态。

历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600 kg，闪电号运载火箭）

注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将载荷移交给客户。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

By measuring the Doppler shift of radio signals from a satellite in a known orbit, it is possible for a receiver on the ground to establish their location, which would have many applications both civilian and military. To test the principle and develop receiver equipment, it is necessary to have a test navigational satellite in orbit.
Historical example: Transit 1B (119 kg, Thor-Ablestar).

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh:
项目：早期专注效益应用
类型：必要

通过测量已知轨道上卫星发射无线电信号的多普勒频移，地面接收机可以确定自身位置，这在民用和军用领域都有广泛的应用。为了验证这一原理并研发接收设备，需要发射一颗试验导航卫星进入轨道。
历史参考：子午仪 1B（119 kg，雷神-爱布尔星）。

注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将载荷移交给客户。

src: The EAS 316 is a lightweight observation pod that works in the same way as the EAS-1 External Command Seat. Features a 'No key' start button, though that just means that the pilots have normally gone back to the KSC to find the non-existent keys on launch.
zh: EAS 316 是一款轻型观测舱，其运作方式与 EAS-1 外部指令座椅相同。虽然配备了“无钥匙”启动按钮，但这通常只意味着飞行员在发射时又跑回 KSC 去找根本不存在的钥匙了。

src: Level II Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Mercury and Vostok. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization to simulate the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 50% Can Hold Satellite Payload, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 23% lighter than level I service module tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 8% more once tooled.
zh: II 级服务舱储罐类似于水星号和东方号所使用的类型。这类重型储罐的容积利用率较低，用于模拟专业有效载荷所需的支撑结构和系统。最大容积利用率：50% 可容纳卫星载荷、电能和生命保障补给 它的重量比 I 级服务舱储罐轻 23%，但工装成本增加 50%，工装后的制造成本增加 8%。

src: Level III Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Gemini and Voskhod. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization that simulates the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 60% Can Hold Satellite Payload, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 40% lighter than level II service module tanks while costing 15% more to tool and the same once tooled.
zh: III 级服务舱储罐类似于双子座号和上升号所使用的类型。这类重型储罐的容积利用率较低，用于模拟专业有效载荷所需的支撑结构和系统。最大容积利用率：60% 可容纳卫星载荷、电能和生命保障补给 它的重量比 II 级服务舱储罐轻 40%，工装成本增加 15%，工装后的制造成本相同。

src: Level IV Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Apollo. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization that simulates the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 75% Can Hold Satellite Payload, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 45% lighter than level III service module tanks while costing 14% more to tool and 7% more once tooled.
zh: IV 级服务舱储罐类似于阿波罗号所使用的类型。这类重型储罐的容积利用率较低，用于模拟专业有效载荷所需的支撑结构和系统。最大容积利用率：75% 可容纳卫星载荷、电能和生命保障补给 它的重量比 III 级服务舱储罐轻 45%，但工装成本增加 14%，工装后的制造成本增加 7%。
